violations.text: Food items in the 3 Door Refrigerator were observed at 44-49 degrees Fahrenheit. Food items were moved to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

At he time of inspection, the following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment: - The automatic paper towel dispenser was observed not dispensing paper towels (batteries possibly no good). - The faucet to the 3-bay sink was observed dripping when all controls were in the off position. - The 3 Door Reach-In Cooler with dressings and chicken was observed at 47 degrees Fahrenheit with foods (dressings, sour cream, and raw chicken) at 44-49 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit is not to be used for storage of Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Foods until properly adjusted/repaired and holding an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. - The gasket to the 3 Door Reach-In Cooler was observed ripped/torn Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of residue. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment are to be cleaned often enough to preclude the build of food, residues, and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3 bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system pre-flush sprayer shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The floor in the kitchen area are in poor repair. Floor tiles and the sealed coating under the cookline were observed to be cracked/chipped exposing the subflooring below. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. The kitchen floor is to be maintained as durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

At the time of inspection, an allergen statement was not available for customer viewing at the point of purchase or on menus/menu boards. An allergen statement is to be supplied. (Allergen Awareness Statement was printed and put in place at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/29/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris... - The cookline metal hood/hood filters - The ice machine Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3 bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system pre-flush sprayer shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap. New Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024

The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. The kitchen floor is to be maintained as durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2024
